scripts.setup: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.noru:start: npm run setup && (docker compose up --build || docker-compose up --build)
scripts.noru:clean: docker compose down -v --rmi all || docker-compose down -v --rmi all
scripts.noru:restart: docker compose down --remove-orphans && (docker compose up --build || docker-compose up --build)
